faq.question: What does Hauwau mean?
faq.answer: Hauwau is associated with the Arabic form حَوَّاء, whose core sense is hauwau; eve (hausa form).

faq.question: What is the origin of Hauwau?
faq.answer: Hauwau is associated with Arabic. Hauwau is the Hausa form of Arabic حَوَّاء (Ḥawwāʾ), the name of Eve.

faq.question: Is Hauwau an Arabic name?
faq.answer: Yes — the underlying form حَوَّاء is Arabic.

faq.question: Is Hauwau an Islamic name?
faq.answer: Hauwau can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.question: Is Hauwau a Quranic name?
faq.answer: Hauwau should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Ḥawwāʾ is not a Quranic personal name, though Eve is referred to in the Quran.
